era: 2019 realtor.com as every visitor saw it (Arquivo.pt captures January, July and October 2019 agree): white header with the red serif realtor.com wordmark, Buy / Sell / Rent / Mortgage / Find Realtors® / My Home / News & Insights with a red underline on the current item, Log In / Sign Up / Advertise on the right, a 'Get Pre-Approved' strip, a grey photo hero 'The Home of Home Search' with BUY / RENT / JUST SOLD / HOME VALUE tabs over a white search field and a red Search button; search results with a map, a filter bar and photo cards; listing pages with a photo gallery, price, beds/baths/sqft and a contact-agent form; dark footer with social icons, About us / Careers / Feedback / Media room / Ad Choices / Advertise with us / Agent support / Privacy / Terms / Home Made / Tech Blog / Sitemap, PRODUCTS and NEWS CORP rows.
